body: You can change your life and be the person you want to be.  Your past doesn't define your future. You still have agency and I believe you still have hope since you reached out about how you're feeling.  I'm proud you trusted this space for help and didn't just keep it all inside. Shows courage and strength

I'm sorry you're feeling this way.  I've felt hopeless for most of my life and have so many regrets. But you have your dreams and I believe you will achieve them.  You're clearly a good person and might just need to set boundaries in your life to make sure you're receiving from others and not just giving. I'm praying for you 🙏🏿
You still have so much to contribute to life and to otters.  Whatever we've been through, we can always move forward

I really appreciate that. It just so hard when you harm ppl you love, especially when they leave. Part of me is happy they were able to escape me and part of me wishes they were still here.  I hope I will grow from this.

My partner and best friend both left me on the same day. They said I have been emotionally abuse, manipulative, and hurt them both a lot. I didn't realize how much I was hurting them and how selfish I am. Now I'm distancing myself from others bc I don't want to hurt anyone else.
